evidenceBasis: Current operator schedules, official attraction prices, a live nearby June 2027 PIT–KEF fare signal, historical climate/sea proxies, and exact internal itinerary arithmetic.
confidenceBasis: The route shape and itemized arithmetic are high-confidence derived facts. Overall confidence is medium because the exact June 10–23 stopover airfare, operating days, lodging, cars, and 2027 hydrofoils are not yet quoted together.

budget.rationale: Six itemized categories reconcile exactly to $10,400–$14,900, but the complete stopover/open-jaw family quote and lodging stack remain unconfirmed. Because the estimate is medium confidence and within $100 of the preferred maximum, the rubric caps Budget at 2/5 until the full 2027 stack is quoted.

weather.rationale: Four Iceland nights retain cool wind/rain exposure, while seven Campania nights are warm and generally dry. The combined route is materially better than Iceland alone but not uniformly beach-weather.

swim.rationale: The itinerary schedules municipal geothermal water, Secret Lagoon, Negombo/San Montano, and at least five additional warm-sea days. The Italy segment is explicitly designed around a 74–77°F historical planning range.

variety.rationale: The canonical days cover waterfalls, geysers, black sand, geothermal pools, volcanic Reykjanes, castles, marine reserves, sandy beaches, Greek temples and sea caves.

ease.rationale: Four lodging bases, one mid-trip flight, rail, two hydrofoils and two rental cars create meaningful operational load despite the deliberate Fiumicino buffer.

food.rationale: Every base and remote day has independently named pizza, pasta, burger, fries, sandwich or grocery fallbacks; Forio and Palinuro have first-party operator confirmation.

risk.rationale: The precise 2027 stopover operating days remain a booking gate, June 14 chains three transport modes, and both Iceland and boat days are condition-sensitive. The airport buffer lowers but does not erase the risk.

nights.rationale: Twelve hotel nights derive 5/5 under the canonical rubric.

novelty.rationale: Iceland and the less-visited Ischia/Cilento combination provide strong novelty, moderated by prior Italy overlap in the family profile.

pto.rationale: Eight PTO days assume an after-work June 10 departure and employer observance of Juneteenth on Friday June 18; PTO remains zero-weight in the baked total.
